discription: A square wave with a rhythmic pulsing amplitude modulation, great for creating textured pads or percussive elements.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseRate=4;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);var pulseLFO = LFO.ar(pulseRate, 0, 0.5, 0.5);sig = Pulse.ar(freq, 0.5) * amp * env * pulseLFO;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
